Dated this the 18th day of December, 2025 This is a petition filed under Section 528 of B.N.S.S., by the accused in Crime No. 249 of 2023 of Valappatanam Police Station, which is pending as C.C. No.
428 of 2023 on the file of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-II, Kannur.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-II, Kannur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The offences alleged against the petitioner are under Sections 498A, 323 IPC.
2.

The prosecution case is that the accused being the husband of the defacto complainant subjected her to cruelty both physically and mentally on the ground of dowry and voluntarily caused hurt to her and thereby he is alleged to have committed the aforesaid offences.
3. According to the petitioner, the dispute has been amicably settled with the defacto complainant and that she had agreed to drop all further proceedings relating to the above dispute.
Therefore, the petitioner prayed for quashing all further proceedings against him.
4. The defacto complainant filed affidavit endorsing the averments in the Criminal MC.
According to her, the case has been amicably settled and that she does not intend to proceed with the case and also that further proceedings in the case can be quashed.
She has no further grievance against the petitioner.

The learned Public Prosecutor, after getting instruction from the investigating officer also submitted that the dispute has been amicably settled between the parties and that the victim is not Muhammed Jaseer K.T.P vs State Of Kerala on 18 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26706508/

6.

sentences.text:
Considering the fact that the offence involved in this case is not heinous and very serious, but purely a matrimonial and private dispute, which has been amicably settled between the parties,
quashment of further proceedings is necessary for maintaining harmonious relationship between the parties.
In the result, this Crl. M.C is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioner in C.C. No. 428 of 2023 on the file of Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-II, Kannur arising from Crime No. 249 of 2023 of Valappatanam Police Station, stands quashed under Section 528 of B.N.S.S. Sd/-
